name: finch-wechat-bot
description: Connect WeChat to Finch through iLink with QR login, inbox sessions, proactive messaging, and Space tasks.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2022 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build
